map.墙面粉刷、地板铺设、瓷砖铺贴、混凝土配比、电路负载、楼梯设计，一站搞定: Wall paint, flooring, tiling, concrete mix, circuit load and stair design, all in one
map.输入墙体尺寸和门窗信息，自动计算所需涂料用量: Enter wall size and door/window info to auto-compute paint needed
map.根据房间面积和地板规格，计算所需片数和包数: By room area and flooring spec, compute plank count and boxes
map.输入铺贴面积和瓷砖规格，计算所需片数: Enter tiling area and tile spec to compute count
map.按标准配比计算水泥、砂、石、水的用量: Compute cement, sand, stone and water by standard mix
map.* 水泥密度按 1440 kg/m³，砂密度按 1500 kg/m³，石密度按: * Density estimate: cement 1440 kg/m3, sand 1500 kg/m3, stone 1600 kg/m3, water 1000 kg/m3
map.输入电器功率和电压，计算电流并推荐断路器与线径: Enter appliance power and voltage to compute current and recommend breaker and wire
map.断路器推荐安数 = 电流 x 1.25（向上取整到标准规格）: Recommended breaker (A) = current x 1.25 (round up to standard)
map.线径推荐参考家用标准铜线载流量: Wire size by household copper ampacity
map.根据层高计算踏步数、步宽和总水平长度: By floor height compute step count, tread and total run
map.* 实际设计中需考虑建筑规范和预留空间: * Actual design must consider building code and clearance
map.建筑家居计算器是一款专为装修、施工场景设计的综合计算工具，涵盖墙面粉刷、地板铺设: The Building & Home Calculator is a suite for renovation/construction, covering wall paint, flooring, tiling, concrete mix, circuit load and stair design to quickly estimate material use and plan work.
map.装修交底前用综合器一次性估出涂料、地板、瓷砖用量，形成采购清单初稿。: Before handover, use the suite to estimate paint, flooring and tile at once into a purchase draft.
map.对比『自购材料』与『全包』的用量口径，避免被重复计费。: Compare self-buy vs full-package quantity bases to avoid double billing.
map.把各项结果汇总成预算表，标出波动大的项（异形损耗）重点复核。: Sum results into a budget, flag volatile items (irregular waste) for review.

Paint ~72 x 2.5 (coat factor) x 1.1 ~ 198 m2

map.综合器能替代分项计算吗？: Can the suite replace per-item calc?
map.不能。它做总量初估，异形房间、拼花、管洞等需回到分项工具细算，本结果仅供统筹。: No. It gives a total estimate; irregular rooms, patterns and openings need the per-item tool; this is for planning only.
map.地板/瓷砖裁切损耗高，涂料滚涂损耗低；本工具按常规值，特殊工艺需上调。: Flooring/tile cutting waste is high, paint rolling low; this tool uses norms; special work needs more.
map.建议先按此列清单比价，最终以商家实测复尺与合同为准，避免量差纠纷。: List and compare first; final follows the merchant re-measure and contract to avoid quantity disputes.
